expected_symptom: A lit test format/mechanism exists that lets an individual .hlsl/.ll file under tools/clang/test/HLSLFileCheckLit get the same hash-stability coverage a file under tools/clang/test/HLSLFileCheck gets today via the TAEF CodeGenHashStability* tests, so a file can move from HLSLFileCheck to HLSLFileCheckLit without losing coverage.
godbolt_skip: Pure test-infrastructure (lit test-runner) feature request with no shader repro; Compiler Explorer compiles a single HLSL source through fixed compiler panes and cannot express or evaluate lit test-format/runner capability.
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: Test-infrastructure feature request, not a compiler bug -- no lit-native hash-stability mechanism exists on main (HLSLFileCheckLit has 29 files, none hash-tested; HLSLFileCheck has 2212, hash-tested only via 10 TAEF CodeGenHashStability* methods). A same-day fix attempt, PR #5600 ('Fixes #5595'), added a DxcHashTest lit format and got three weeks of substantive maintainer review, but stalled unmerged on an unresolved design objection (does not respect lit local-config traversal); its last commit is 2023-09-22 and gh/git both confirm it was never merged. Duplicate issue #5552 was closed in favor of this one. Issue text remains accurate.
title: [Feature Request] support hash stability test in lit
